adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the prior PATCH “incremental” specs that explicitly asserted silent-success behavior for edge cases (adding a non-existent user and removing a non-member) in `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb` (the whole `context 'incremental'` block is deleted). The new endpoint specs added under `context ".add_members"` and `context ".remove_member"` only cover adding valid users and removing an existing member, plus automatic-group rejection, but do not reintroduce assertions for those edge cases. The controller implementations still appear to preserve the silent behavior (`add_members` skips when `User.find_by_username` returns nil; `remove_member` calls `group.users.delete(user_id)` which is typically a no-op if not a member), so the issue is specifically missing regression coverage for the new endpoints, not a demonstrated runtime defect in the diff.
